nodes.label: Access token kept in Redux memory only, never localStorage
nodes.norm_label: access token kept in redux memory only, never localstorage
nodes.rationale: Deliberate backend constraint: the Auth API doesn't set an httpOnly refresh cookie, so only REFRESH_TOKEN falls back to localStorage; the access token is never persisted and is re-fetched via tokenRefresh after a reload.

nodes.label: Two-tier API layer (axiosInstance vs raw axios)
nodes.norm_label: two-tier api layer (axiosinstance vs raw axios)
nodes.rationale: Bearer-protected endpoints use axiosInstance (auto-attaches Authorization, retries once on 401/403 via tokenRefresh, force logout on failure); unauthenticated endpoints (login/refresh/forgot-password) use raw axios directly to avoid recursing into refresh logic.

nodes.label: Two-zone routing architecture (logged-out vs protected)
nodes.rationale: App splits into logged-out (/login, /forgot-password) and protected (/app/*) zones; a hard reload on /app/* currently drops the session because there is no 'me' endpoint to re-hydrate state.auth.user from the refresh token alone.

nodes.label: One-auth-loader-on-parent-route pattern
nodes.rationale: Only the parent /app route carries an auth loader (AuthLoaderChecker), not every child route, to avoid redundant auth checks per the reference pattern.

nodes.label: toNotify-only notification convention
nodes.rationale: Always call toNotify, never notifications.show directly, so styling/icons/auto-close per type stay centralized in one place.

nodes.label: identifier field accepts email or phone gotcha
nodes.norm_label: identifier field accepts email or phone gotcha
nodes.rationale: The Auth API's identifier field accepts email or phone, so it must not be validated as strict email format.

nodes.label: resetToken short-lived, page-state-only gotcha
nodes.rationale: resetToken from /auth/verify-otp is short-lived and single-purpose; keep it in page-level React state only, never localStorage/sessionStorage or a URL param.

nodes.label: Presentational form components convention
nodes.rationale: Pages own submission (dispatch thunk, try/catch + .unwrap(), local loading state); form components stay presentational, only validating and calling onSubmit, to keep them reusable/testable in isolation.

nodes.label: PinInput uncontrolled-incompatibility gotcha
nodes.rationale: Mantine's PinInput isn't @mantine/form uncontrolled-compatible and its error prop is boolean not a message string, so use mode: 'controlled' and render validation text separately.

nodes.label: Centralized Mantine-only theming convention
nodes.rationale: Rely on Mantine's own color-scheme handling instead of per-file dark/light token objects; centralize any new tokens in theme.ts.
